bottleneck: Routing+dispatch composed of ~20 small torch CUDA kernels (gatherTopK, scatter, reduce, cub, index_* etc.) sums to ~44% of 0.58 ms kernel time at seq=1 — per-kernel launch overhead (~10us each) dominates over the actual math; GEMM1+GEMM2 are already tiny (~0.32 ms combined). The 0.94 ms measured end-to-end has ~0.36 ms of CPU-side / python-side overhead on top.
target_metric: end-to-end latency (ms) at seq=1 — proxy for routing+dispatch floor
winning_technique: Triton-fused routing (iter 1) + two-pass Triton dispatch kernels replacing torch.argsort/bincount/index_select chain (iter 10) + `is_local.any()` sync removal (iter 7) + `-1` sentinel local-expert emission (iter 9) + fused fp32→bf16 cast kernel (iter 12). Short-class representative dropped 0.939→0.373 ms, 2.52× faster than Phase-2 autotuned baseline.

bottleneck: GEMM1+SwiGLU 43.6% + GEMM2+scatter 37.9% together account for 81% of 2.4 ms kernel time at seq=901; balanced split, neither GEMM saturates on its own. Routing overhead is still ~18%. Primary lever: per-GEMM efficiency (better pipeline overlap, tl.dot scaled, or intermediate quantization).
winning_technique: Benefits from every short-class dispatch / routing win (the same code path). Additional gain from iter 3 bf16 intermediate buffer (halves GEMM2 LHS HBM bytes) which targets the ~38% GEMM2-share for this class. Medium-class rep dropped 1.801→1.202 ms, 1.50× faster than Phase-2.

bottleneck: GEMM2+scatter 55.6% + GEMM1+SwiGLU 33.3% together own 89% of 15.9 ms kernel time at seq=14107; GEMM2 is the clear single dominant kernel because its K=I=2048 is tiny but N=H=7168 × sum_Tk≈14k is enormous, and GEMM2's LHS is the fp32 SwiGLU intermediate (4× the HBM bytes of an FP8 LHS). Primary lever: quantize the GEMM1->GEMM2 intermediate to fp8 + block scale, and/or increase GEMM2 tile occupancy.
winning_technique: Only partial win: iter 3 bf16 intermediate (−2% on rep) + iter 7 sync drop (−1%). Class mean (11948+14107)/2 dropped 7.24→6.11 ms. Stuck after multiple attempts at native FP8 dot (numerical fail), scale-out-of-K-loop (pipeline disfusion), GROUP_M swizzle (no benefit at this tile count), fp8-intermediate quant kernel (compile error), persistent grids (compile error / L2 thrash). Primary remaining lever remains fp8 intermediate with a cleanly-structured quant kernel; requires a Triton-version-specific fp8 cast path.
